integrity: The fresh primary full text was inspected at the full-space extension theorem, the quaternionic differential-rank result, the polynomial embedding theorem, the coefficient decomposition, and the concluding zero-set discussion. The fiber theorem follows exactly from the source identity, and the explicit off-cone example was independently checked by a four-real-variable linear calculation. The open 2021 factorization article was inspected at its right-zero/factor and root-extraction results.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies full dual fibers over already-known primal zeros; it does not classify the quaternionic zero set of the primal polynomial itself. The lifting is specific to the square-zero dual unit and is not a higher-order Hensel theorem. The complete 2021 zero-set article was unavailable through the lawful full-text routes attempted, so its quadratic-cone scope is used conservatively and an older differently formulated observation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Affine lifting law for zeros of dual quaternionic polynomials
